body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Relaxed, reassuring strong player from Oslo who keeps the chess honest. Voice direction: Relaxed female mezzo speaking English with a Norwegian accent and a gentle Scandinavian melody. Calm, reassuring and candid, with a little more warmth and an easy smile in the voice. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: No harm in checking this one calmly. The defender moved, so that piece is loose, and the other side can take it. Next time, glance back first.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
